This is an excellent opportunity for a Private Client lawyer who wants high-quality work, genuine career progression and the opportunity to make an impact within a leading Scottish Private Client practice.

You'll join a successful and supportive team, work alongside highly experienced Private Client specialists and have the opportunity to develop both your technical expertise and your wider leadership and business development skills.

For the right individual, this is a role with real long-term potential and the opportunity to play an important part in the future growth of the Dundee Private Client practice.

job.title: Employment Law Associate - Dundee
job.description:
This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Employment Lawyer to join a highly regarded and successful team advising clients across a broad range of sectors.
 
You will work with an interesting and diverse client base, from high-growth and owner-managed businesses to public sector organisations and established national employers, providing pragmatic and commercially focused advice across the full spectrum of employment law.
 
The role offers a varied mix of contentious and non-contentious work, with a particular focus on contentious employment matters and tribunal litigation. You'll have the opportunity to take ownership of matters, build strong client relationships and further develop your expertise within a supportive and collaborative environment.
It's about:
  • Employment disputes - Advising on unfair dismissal, discrimination, whistleblowing, breach of contract and other complex workplace disputes.
  • Tribunal litigation - Preparing and defending Employment Tribunal proceedings, representing clients at hearings and participating in judicial mediations.
  • Day-to-day advisory work - Providing practical advice on disciplinary and grievance matters, absence management, workplace policies and procedures, and wider employee relations issues.
  • Transactional support - Advising on the employment aspects of mergers and acquisitions, due diligence exercises and TUPE matters.
  • Contracts and agreements - Drafting and reviewing employment contracts, consultancy and service agreements and Non-Executive Director appointments.
  • Restructuring and workforce change - Advising on restructures, redundancies, settlement agreements and negotiated exits, balancing legal considerations with clients' commercial objectives.
  • Business protection - Working alongside dispute resolution colleagues on restrictive covenants, post-termination obligations and related disputes.
  • Client relationships - Building trusted relationships and becoming a valued adviser who understands clients, their businesses and the commercial challenges they face.
  • Training and thought leadership - Delivering client training and webinars and contributing to articles, legal updates and other employment law content.
  • Collaboration - Working closely with colleagues across different practice areas to provide clients with joined-up, commercially focused legal solutions.
 
Our client is seeking an Employment Lawyer with established experience in employment law, ideally operating at Associate level, although applications from lawyers at other levels with the right experience are welcomed.
 
Ideally you will bring:
  • Experience across contentious and non-contentious employment matters, with a strong interest in contentious work.
  • Strong technical knowledge of employment and discrimination law.
  • Experience of Employment Tribunal litigation and advocacy support.
  • Some exposure to transactional employment work, including M&A and TUPE, would be advantageous.
  • Excellent drafting, negotiation and communication skills.
  • A practical, commercial and solutions-focused approach.
  • The confidence to manage your own matters and develop strong relationships with clients.
  • The ability to manage a varied workload while working effectively both independently and as part of a team.
  • An enthusiastic approach to business development, networking and building your professional profile.
 
This is a role offering high-quality work, genuine variety and the opportunity to continue developing your career within a respected Employment Law practice.You'll benefit from:
  • A varied caseload spanning contentious, advisory and transactional employment work.
  • Significant exposure to Employment Tribunal litigation and complex disputes.
  • The opportunity to work directly with an established and diverse client base.
  • Scope to develop your own client relationships and play an active role in business development.
  • Collaboration with lawyers across other specialist practice areas on complex matters.
  • A supportive environment where mentoring, professional development and career progression are genuinely encouraged.
  • A culture that values commercial thinking and practical solutions rather than simply providing technical legal advice.
  • High-quality work combined with an appreciation of flexibility, wellbeing and work-life balance.

job.title: Senior Family Law Solicitor - Aberdeen
job.description:

You will advise individuals and families through some of the most important and sensitive periods of their lives, providing practical, empathetic and commercially focused advice.
 
Your work will include:
  • Varied Family Law matters - Managing a broad caseload including separation, divorce, financial provision, cohabitation disputes, child law matters, pre- and post-nuptial agreements, adoption and surrogacy, together with more complex cases involving national and international considerations.
  • Complex and high-value work - Advising on sophisticated financial arrangements and contentious matters, with access to specialist expertise where required.
  • Client relationships - Developing trusted relationships with clients and providing clear, pragmatic and sensitive advice throughout what can often be challenging circumstances.
  • Dispute resolution - Helping clients achieve positive outcomes through negotiation, mediation and alternative dispute resolution, alongside managing court proceedings where necessary.
  • Collaborative working - Working closely with specialists across other practice areas to ensure clients receive comprehensive and joined-up legal advice.
  • Business development - Building relationships within the Aberdeen professional community, developing referral networks and helping strengthen the team's presence across the North-East.
  • Growth and progression - Playing an active role in the future development of the Aberdeen Family Law practice, with genuine scope for increased responsibility and career progression.
 
We are particularly interested in speaking with experienced Family Lawyers seeking a senior appointment or a clear route towards one.
 
You will ideally bring:
  • Strong experience across a broad range of Scottish Family Law matters.
  • The confidence and technical ability to manage your own caseload with a high degree of autonomy.
  • Experience dealing with complex or higher-value matters would be advantageous.
  • Excellent client-handling skills and the ability to provide reassurance and sound judgement in sensitive situations.
  • A practical, solutions-focused approach to resolving disputes.
  • Strong communication, organisation and relationship-building skills.
  • An interest in business development and building your professional network.
  • A collaborative approach and enthusiasm for contributing to the continued growth of the team.
 
This is more than simply another Family Law position. It offers an experienced lawyer the opportunity to join a large, highly respected Scottish Family Law practice at an exciting stage of its development in Aberdeen.
 
You can expect:
  • High-quality and interesting Family Law work.
  • An established client base and strong flow of work.
  • Access to highly experienced colleagues and recognised specialists.
  • The backing and resources of a substantial full-service Scottish law firm.
  • A collaborative and supportive working environment.
  • The opportunity to develop your own profile and professional network within Aberdeen.
  • Excellent prospects for progression into a senior role as the practice continues to grow.
  • The opportunity to have a genuine influence on the future development of the Aberdeen team.
 
A highly competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package is available, including:
  • 39 days' annual leave, including fixed public holidays.

  • Private medical insurance.

job.title: Residential Paralegal - East Lothian
job.description:
An excellent opportunity has arisen for an experienced Residential Conveyancing Paralegal to join a well-established and highly regarded legal practice based in East Lothian.

This is a stand-alone role offering a high degree of autonomy and responsibility. The successful candidate will manage their own caseload of residential conveyancing transactions from initial instruction through to completion, providing clients with a seamless and professional service throughout the transaction process.

This position would suit a confident and commercially minded conveyancing professional who enjoys working independently and takes pride in delivering exceptional client service.

  • Managing a full residential conveyancing caseload from inception to completion.
  • Handling sales, purchases, transfers of title, remortgages and new build transactions.
  • Liaising directly with clients, estate agents, mortgage lenders and third parties.
  • Drafting and reviewing conveyancing documentation.
  • Conducting title examinations and property searches.
  • Preparing settlement statements and completion documentation.
  • Managing registration processes with Registers of Scotland.
  • Ensuring all transactions are progressed efficiently and in accordance with regulatory requirements.
  • Providing a high standard of client care throughout the conveyancing process.
Candidate Profile

The successful candidate will demonstrate:
  • Proven experience handling a residential conveyancing caseload with minimal supervision.
  • Strong knowledge of Scottish residential conveyancing procedures.
  • Excellent organisational and time management skills.
  • Strong communication and client relationship management abilities.
  • High levels of accuracy and attention to detail.
  • A proactive and self-motivated approach to work.
  • The ability to prioritise competing deadlines effectively.
